title: Shinier dishes & cutlery
description: Crumple aluminium foil into a ball and place it in the dishwasher cutlery basket to help shiny metal items look cleaner.
tips: Use a ball about the size of a golf ball for best results.
Replace the foil ball every few washes for maximum effect.
Works best with stainless steel cutlery.

title: Stop pots from boiling over
description: Place a wooden spoon across the top of a pot to reduce messy boil-overs.
tips: Any wooden spoon works — the longer the better.
Also works with a wooden chopstick laid across the rim.
The wood absorbs heat and breaks surface tension.

title: Protect car doors
description: Cut a pool noodle and attach it to the garage wall to protect your car doors.
tips: Use strong double-sided tape or screws to mount securely.
Cut the noodle lengthwise for a flatter profile on the wall.
Choose a bright colour that is easy to spot in low garage lighting.

title: Charge faster
description: Put your phone on airplane mode while charging to reduce background activity.
tips: Airplane mode stops all background app refresh activity.
Combined with a quality cable, charging can be 30% faster.
Turn off WiFi and Bluetooth too for maximum speed.

title: Freeze grapes
description: Freeze grapes and use them instead of ice cubes in drinks.
tips: Freeze in a single layer on a tray before bagging.
Red and green grapes both work great.
They also make a healthy frozen snack on their own.

title: Sharpen scissors
description: Cut through a few folded layers of foil to help sharpen dull scissors.
tips: Fold 6 to 8 layers of foil for best sharpening effect.
Cut through the stack 10 to 15 times.
Works on kitchen shears and fabric scissors too.

title: Remove water rings from wood
description: Use a hairdryer on low heat to remove white water ring marks from wooden furniture.
tips: Hold the dryer about 5cm from the surface.
Move it in slow circles so you do not scorch the wood.
Follow up with a little furniture polish to restore shine.

title: Keep bananas fresh longer
description: Wrap the crown of a banana bunch in cling wrap to slow the ripening process.
tips: Separate bananas from the bunch to slow ripening even more.
Store away from other fruits — bananas emit ethylene gas.
Already ripe? Peel and freeze them for smoothies.

title: Fix a stripped screw hole
description: Stuff a few toothpicks with wood glue into a stripped screw hole, let dry, then re-drive the screw.
tips: Break the toothpicks off flush once the glue dries.
Use PVA wood glue for the best bond.
Works on door hinges, cabinet handles and furniture.

title: Stop shoes from squeaking
description: Sprinkle baby powder under the inner sole of squeaky shoes to reduce friction noise.
tips: Remove the inner sole first for best results.
Cornstarch works just as well as baby powder.
Reapply every few weeks as it wears off.

title: Keep car windscreen frost-free
description: Mix 3 parts vinegar with 1 part water and spray on your windscreen the night before to prevent frost.
tips: Apply in the evening before frost is expected.
Also works on side mirrors.
The vinegar smell disappears once it dries.

title: Unclog a drain naturally
description: Pour baking soda followed by white vinegar down a slow drain, wait 15 minutes, then flush with hot water.
tips: Use half a cup of baking soda and half a cup of vinegar.
Cover the drain after adding vinegar to force the fizz downward.
Repeat monthly to keep drains clear.

title: Remove sticky labels easily
description: Use a hairdryer on medium heat for 20-30 seconds to soften the adhesive, then peel the label off cleanly.
tips: Hold the hairdryer about 5cm from the label.
Peel slowly from one corner to avoid tearing.
Rub any leftover residue with cooking oil or white vinegar.

title: Bread Clip Cable Labels
description: Use old bread clips to label your cables so you never mix them up again.
tips: Write the cable name on the bread clip with a permanent marker.
Clip it onto the cable near the plug end for easy identification.
Use different coloured bread clips to colour-code by room or device.

title: Make Shoes Smell Fresh
description: Makes your shoes & sneakers smell fresh.
tips: Put dry tea bags inside shoes overnight.
Leave until morning.
Tea bags absorb moisture and odours.
Shoes smell fresher.

title: Use a Peg to Hold a Nail
description: Saves your fingers from getting hit.
tips: Clip the nail with a clothes peg.
Hold the peg instead of the nail.
Hammer safely.

title: Lemon in Microwave for Easy Cleaning
tips: Put lemon slices in a bowl of water.
Microwave for 3 minutes.
Let steam sit for 2 minutes.
Wipe away.
